content.short: Netswap is the premier native AMM DEX on Metis Andromeda featuring liquidity mining and a launchpad.
content.description:
Netswap is the leading native decentralized exchange and automated market maker (AMM) built on the Metis Andromeda Layer 2 network. As a comprehensive DeFi hub, the platform offers users a seamless environment for token swaps, liquidity mining, and staking with high throughput and low transaction costs. Netswap also features an integrated launchpad, providing a vital venue for new Metis-based projects to bootstrap liquidity and engage with the community.

Powered by the NETT token, the protocol emphasizes community-driven governance and sustainable growth within the Metis ecosystem. By leveraging Metis's scalable infrastructure, Netswap delivers a professional-grade trading experience that prioritizes user sovereignty and transparent on-chain execution. As a core component of the network's liquidity layer, Netswap is dedicated to providing the essential financial tools needed for participants to explore and expand the decentralized economy on Metis.
content.meta: Netswap provides high-speed AMM trading, yield farming, and a native launchpad for the Metis ecosystem.
